s.d: Agaricus bisporus, the cultivated mushroom, is a basidiomycete mushroom native to grasslands in Eurasia and North America. It is cultivated in more than 70 countries and is one of the most commonly and widely consumed mushrooms in the world. It has two color states while immature – white and brown – both of which have various names, with additional names for the mature state, such as chestnut, portobello, portabellini, button, cremini, and champignon de Paris.

Pleurotus ostreatus, commonly known as the oyster mushroom, grey oyster mushroom, oyster fungus, hiratake, or pearl oyster mushroom, is a popular edible mushroom found in temperate and subtropical forests around the world.

The shiitake is an edible mushroom native to East Asia and mainland Southeast Asia, which is cultivated and consumed around the globe. The earliest written records of their cultivation dates to 1209, during the Song dynasty in China.
s.ew: Raw shiitake can cause a flagellate dermatitis; cook it before eating.

s.d: Cantharellus cibarius is the golden chanterelle, the type species of the chanterelle genus Cantharellus. It is also known as girolle.
Boletus edulis is a basidiomycete fungus, and the type species of the genus Boletus. It is prized as an edible mushroom.
Morchella esculenta, the common morel, is a species of fungus in the family Morchellaceae of the Ascomycota.
s.ew: Raw morels contain hydrazine toxins; cook them thoroughly.

s.d: Amanita muscaria, commonly known as the fly agaric or fly amanita or simply red toadstool, is a basidiomycete fungus of the genus Amanita. It is a distinctive, large, white-gilled mushroom typically featuring a bright red cap covered with white warts. It is a widely distributed mushroom native to temperate and boreal forests of the Northern Hemisphere.
s.ew: Contains ibotenic acid and muscimol; causes delirium, nausea and seizures, and can be fatal. Not a food.

s.d: Psilocybe cubensis, commonly known as the magic mushroom, shroom, golden halo, cube, gold cap, or bluestain smoothcap, is a species of psilocybin mushroom of moderate potency whose principal active compounds are psilocybin and psilocin. It is the best-known psilocybin mushroom due to its wide distribution and ease of cultivation.
s.ew: Contains psilocybin and psilocin; illegal in many countries, and not a food.

s.d: Psilocybe semilanceata, commonly known as the liberty cap, is a species of fungus which produces psilocybin, psilocin and baeocystin. It is one of the most widely distributed psilocybin mushrooms in nature.
s.ew: Contains psilocybin and psilocin; illegal in many countries, and not a food.

s.d: Psilocybe cyanescens, commonly known as the wavy cap or potent psilocybe, is a species of potent psychedelic mushroom. The main compounds responsible for its psychedelic effects are psilocybin and psilocin. It belongs to the family Hymenogastraceae.
s.ew: Contains psilocybin and psilocin; illegal in many countries, and not a food.
